messages:
incident-bot: Alert fired: `PD-4821` — streaming-infer-gateway error-rate > 8% over 1m (auto-pager)
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-4821 created and paged: escalation policy `oncall-sre` — please acknowledge
alex: acked PD-4821, I'm on it :phone:
alex: quick triage — 5xxs appear from `gateway-proxy` -> `model-backend` during short bursts
maria: seeing the same in traces, span latencies spike ~200-600ms then recover
vivek: infra metrics: GPU util at ~88% on gpu-04, context-switches high, but mem usage ok
sre-oncall: checking networking — no drop events, LB healthy
alex: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-14T12:03:22Z gateway-proxy ERROR downstream=502 target=model-backend-12 t=0.45s
2026-03-14T12:03:23Z gateway-proxy ERROR downstream=502 target=model-backend-09 t=0.62s
```
alex: PD shows it flared for ~40s then dropped below threshold
pagerduty-bot: PD-4821 auto-resolved by metric (error-rate < 5% for 1m)
alex: confirmed auto-resolve. Looks like a transient spike — potential flaky backend handshake
maria: any customer impact? quick query shows 18 total 5xx across last 5m, spread across routes — small fraction
vivek: could be KV cache warmup on model-backend or brief model loading jitter
taylor: i've added a temporary 5m suppression rule for this alert to reduce churn while we investigate
alex: suppression makes sense short-term. For follow-up: increase evaluation window from 60s->180s and require sustained error-rate
maria: creating follow-up ticket: INF-1234 — include traces, sample logs, GPU metrics, assign to eng-runtime
sre-oncall: handoff note: i'll be on PTO in 30m, handing oncall to taylor — context added to PD and Ops notes
taylor: thanks — i'll take ownership of the postmortem and alert tuning
alex: no customer-facing outage detected, documenting as flapping/noisy alert. Will monitor for recurrence :eyes:
maria: proposed action items: 1) tune alert window, 2) add kv-warmup metric, 3) investigate model load handshake
vivek: also add a lightweight runbook step to check `model-backend` warmup and GPU transient queues
alex: ok closing the thread here, PD auto-resolved and acknowledged, follow-up INF-1234 created :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Thread note: PD incident PD-4821 auto-resolved. Follow-ups queued: INF-1234."
